insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Cumulative Bonus will not be reduced unless the same is utilized in the event of claim. During Renewal, Cumulative Bonus will be reduced only to the extent of utilized portion and the unutilized Cumulative Bonus will be carried forward to the next policy year.
great.explanation: Your no-claim bonus only reduces if you make a claim using it; otherwise, it accumulates year after year. This protects your bonus and rewards claim-free years.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured: There shall be automatic restoration of the Sum Insured once by 100%... The automatic restoration shall be immediately upon partial/full utilization of the limit of coverage... Such Restored Sum Insured can be utilized for all claims for subsequent Hospitalization during the policy period.
great.reference: Section II – 16. Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured (page 4)
great.explanation: Your full sum insured is restored immediately after you use it once, allowing multiple claims in the same policy year. This gives you extra coverage beyond the base sum insured.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room (Private Single A/c Room), Boarding and Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital / Nursing Home
good.explanation: The policy covers a private single AC room by default, which is standard in the market. You can optionally upgrade to any room type for higher sum insured.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the first policy start date, which is a normal waiting period. You can reduce this with optional covers subject to underwriting.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section IV – 2. Speciﬁed disease/procedure waiting period (Code Excl 02) (page 7)
good.explanation: The policy excludes certain specified illnesses and procedures for 24 months, which is standard practice in India.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days of the policy, but accidents are covered immediately. This is the market standard.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, which aligns with typical industry coverage.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered, providing good post-hospital care support.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: Domiciliary Hospitalization: Coverage for medical treatment (Including AYUSH) for a period exceeding three days
good.explanation: Home-based treatment is covered if it lasts more than three days, including AYUSH therapies, which is a useful benefit.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Air Ambulance... reimbursement of expenses incurred towards the cost of air ambulance service up to 10% of sum insured per policy year
good.explanation: Air ambulance costs are covered up to 10% of the sum insured per year, providing valuable emergency transport support.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatment: The following procedures will be covered... upto sum insured...
good.explanation: Modern medical procedures like robotic surgery and immunotherapy are covered up to the sum insured, ensuring access to advanced care.

good.name: Optional Covers
good.quote: SECTION III - OPTIONAL COVERS... Modiﬁcation of Room Category... Reduction of Pre-Existing Diseases Waiting Period... Coverage for Non-medical Items (Consumables)... Unlimited Automatic Restoration of Sum Insured... Cumulative Bonus Booster
good.explanation: You can choose optional add-ons like room upgrades, reduced PED waiting, consumables cover, unlimited restoration, and bonus boosters to enhance your policy.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Other Excluded Expenses as detailed in List I (68 items)... (except to those who opted for Optional Cover Section III – 4) - Code Excl 37.
bad.explanation: Non-medical consumables like gloves and masks are not covered by default and require an optional add-on, meaning you may pay out-of-pocket otherwise.

bad.name: Domiciliary Exclusions
bad.quote: However, this beneﬁt shall not cover Asthma, Bronchitis... Diabetes Mellitus and Insipidus... Hypertension... Cough and Cold... Arthritis, Gout and Rheumatism.
bad.explanation: Several common chronic conditions are excluded from domiciliary hospitalization, limiting the usefulness of home treatment coverage.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement... (definition only; no percentage/age-based co-pay terms found in provided pages)
bad.reference: Section I – Definitions: Co-Payment (page 1) / No explicit co-pay clause located in provided extract
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-payment but does not clearly state if or how much co-pay applies by default. Check the policy schedule or full wording for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
